title: Adding an HLL sketch blob type to the Puffin spec
summary: Yuya Ebihara opened a PR (#18513) to add a standard HyperLogLog blob type, apache-datasketches-hll-v1, to the Puffin spec. Puffin currently defines only apache-datasketches-theta-v1 for NDV statistics, and Theta sketch computation causes a 10-20% slowdown on inserts in Trino. Trino is considering an HLL option, which without a standard type would have to be stored as an engine-specific blob that other engines cannot read. The new blob would hold a serialized compact Apache DataSketches HLL sketch built with the default seed from values in Iceberg's single-value serialization, with an optional ndv property as for Theta. Four replies were +1; Junwang Zhao (zhjwpku) added that HLL uses less memory and is faster for simple distinct counts. Raghvendra Yadav agreed with the motivation and asked what a reader should do when a table has both Theta and HLL blobs, since they cannot be unioned, and whether the blob metadata should record lgK. Those questions were not answered in the thread.

positions.stance: Puffin should define a standard apache-datasketches-hll-v1 blob type so engines that prefer HLL can write NDV sketches that other engines can read.
HLL should be supported because it uses less memory and is faster for simple distinct counts.
The spec should say how readers handle tables that mix Theta and HLL blobs, which cannot be merged, and should consider recording lgK in the blob metadata.

outcome.note: No decision. Replies supported the proposal; questions about mixing Theta and HLL blobs and recording lgK were left unanswered.

why_it_matters: Without a standard HLL blob type, engines that avoid Theta sketches would write statistics other engines cannot read.
